install: REPO_DIR="$(pwd -P)"; touch ~/.bashrc; sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc; LINE="export PATH=\"${REPO_DIR}/.venv/bin:\$PATH\""; grep -qxF "$LINE" ~/.bashrc || echo "$LINE" >> ~/.bashrc; if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv venv --allow-existing --seed .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e ".[dev]"; else python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-input -e ".[dev]"; fi
